purpose: Determine whether any PlayUZU blackjack configuration has positive contractual long-run EV after exact UZUplus cashback, without prediction, card counting, bonuses or future information.

thresholdMath.rule: effectiveEV = exact_table_RTP_under_exact_basic_strategy + exact_game_UZUplus - any nonincluded costs/commissions. PASS only if a conservative verified lower bound is strictly > 1.0.

requiredPerTableAudit: Exact table/game identity and provider on PlayUZU.
Exact current RTP from the game's own rules, not the generic 99.5% editorial approximation.
Exact UZUplus percentage displayed for that exact game at the same observation time.
Deck count, dealer S17/H17, blackjack payout, double rules, split/resplit rules, surrender and any side-bet/commission rules.
Basic-strategy EV computed for those exact rules; side bets excluded.
Confirm how UZUplus treats doubles/splits and whether cashback applies to all real-money amounts wagered.
Confirm no promotion exclusions, caps or terms reduce the effective cashback.
Recheck RTP and UZUplus immediately before any future economic review because both can change.
